answer: We define a mechanism where identity activation requires staking collateral, validated via a zero-knowledge verifiable delay beacon. An adversarial agent attempting identity multiplication across a canyon of virtual nodes faces subgame-perfect slashing penalties enforced by a cryptographic quill that records misbehavior. Because the expected payoff of generating N Sybil nodes yields a strictly negative utility U(N) = N(R - S) - P < 0, the robust Nash equilibrium converges to honest participation.
